title: TLS certificate verification disabled in internal HTTP client

pr_metadata.title: Unblock ledger calls in staging
pr_metadata.body: Staging ledger uses a self-signed cert; skip verification for now.

labels.defect: InsecureSkipVerify disables server certificate validation for ledger traffic (MITM exposure)
labels.evidence: Reproducible: point the client at any host presenting a self-signed certificate; the handshake succeeds and balance mutations are sent to the attacker. NewClient() has no staging/prod switch, so the setting ships to production.

adjudication.notes: InsecureSkipVerify on financial traffic with no environment gating.
